transcript.text: Today I'd like to explore a topic that is of increasing importance of the economy here in Australia mining I'll start by getting into how mining developed and look at how it's progressed into the multi-billion dollar industry it is now.

transcript.text: Then forth the mining boom of the 1900s the one was still currently experiencing as a direct result of exploration in the Pilbara a region in western Australia. transcript.text: At first the vast majority of Australia's iron exports went to the west but in the 1990s there was a shift in international trade. transcript.text: From the early 2000s onwards it became the biggest importer of Australian iron in the world. In fact over the first 10 years of the millennium China's demand grew so much that 70% of Australia's iron ore is now sent there.
